This door is a picture of fame and success.   When one enters the Scenery Door, their voice can be assured that it will travel far and wide.  Statements become definitive and persuasive; ideas become charming and creative.  This door is best used for purposes of sales and marketing, as the audience will surely find the magnetic attraction a sight to behold.  Those born with the Scenery Door have a controlling presence in social situations.  They project a feeling of optimistic enthusiasm that can easily take the world by storm.

death.$body:
The Death Door is the gateway to renewal.  It is the end of the road but also the beginning of a new adventure.  It can be visualized as a seed waiting to sprout into the essence of nature.

When one enters the Death Door, he will be able to understand the circle of life.  Dualities of black and white, strong and weak, hard and soft become one and the same.  One will cease to become selfish, as they will see themselves as part of a greater whole.  The Death Door is the giver of emotions.  Those who are born with it have the ability to experience intense connectedness to the people and things around them. ✭ earth dun 地遁.name: earth dun
✭ earth dun 地遁.description: The Earth Den is an auspicious image of solid, stable things.  Extremely auspicious for maintaining order and keeping the status quo, this formation will give energy to those who are on a step-by-step climb to reach their goals.  This formation supports internal growth in a manner that is predictable and welcomed.

✭ man dun 人遁.name: man dun
✭ man dun 人遁.description: This auspicious formation paints a picture of a visionary giving orders in the center of the stage.  Extremely beneficial for those who need to rally support, raise morale, and recruit newcomers to the team.

✭ wind dun 風遁.name: wind dun
✭ wind dun 風遁.description: The wind carries all things, as it was said.  This auspicious formation depicts information and memes flowing through society at quick speed.  Marketing endeavors will likely succeed, and word of mouth will grow to support the idea.

✭ tiger dun 虎遁.name: tiger dun
✭ tiger dun 虎遁.description: The tiger is one who attacks without hesitation.  This auspicious formation paints a picture of a courageous leader attempting any and all strategies to achieve his goal, eventually arriving at success.  This formation will bring one persistence and determination to aggressively remove any obstacle standing in the way.

✭ spirit dun 神遁.name: spirit dun
✭ spirit dun 神遁.description: The Spirit Den is arguably the most powerful of the Dens, as it is able to connect the individual to the fifth level of the heavenly sphere.  In Qi Men Dun Jia, the spirit dimension is responsible for the highest uncontrollable forces, and this formation allows one to form a direct connection to this level.

✭ ghost dun 鬼遁.name: ghost dun
✭ ghost dun 鬼遁.description: The Ghost Den is an auspicious formation that gives he who wields it the power of the shadows.  One will achieve the mission while hiding in plain sight.  Enemies will cease to notice; eyes will wander away.  Beneficial for those who wish to surprise the enemy.

✭ yi wonder meets envoy 日奇得使.name: yi wonder meets envoy
✭ yi wonder meets envoy 日奇得使.description: In this formation, the pieces of the game are in the right position.  Team members are focused on their duties, goals are aligned, and motivation is present in all persons.  This is a positive indicator for all wealth, health, and relationship matters.

✭ bing wonder meets envoy 月奇得使.name: bing wonder meets envoy
✭ bing wonder meets envoy 月奇得使.description: As one of the Three Wonders, Bing lights the way for Jia's path.  This formation depicts the noble receiving new opportunities for growth.  Plans will fork into rivers and streams as information will come to the noble at the right moment in time.  Actions taken will seem to fall in place, and decisions will seem solidified.  Suitable for all matters -- including relationships, careers, and business.

✭ ding wonder meets envoy 星奇得使.name: ding wonder meets envoy
✭ ding wonder meets envoy 星奇得使.description: Ding enters the palace of Xun or Geng, receiving the necessary support for Jia.  This auspicious formation suggests positive development at every step.  As long as one is grounded and careful, education, career, and marital pursuits should be well secured.  This is an execellent formation for developing a skill or talent.

✭ yi wonder rises palace 日奇昇殿.name: yi wonder rises palace
✭ yi wonder rises palace 日奇昇殿.description: This auspicious formation is suitable for obtaining information.  Particularly well-suited for negotiation and research matters where specialized knowledge is hard to gain.  The Yi Wonder will assist in revealing such information to the surface.

✭ bing wonder rises palace 月奇昇殿.name: bing wonder rises palace
✭ bing wonder rises palace 月奇昇殿.description: This positive formation depicts a sun shining into darkness, destroying evils and revealing virtue.  Traditionally used by law enforcement to fight crime, this formation is helpful when one's intention can be seen in the light, in which case, progress will likely ascend without hindrance.

✭ ding wonder rises palace 星奇昇殿.name: ding wonder rises palace
✭ ding wonder rises palace 星奇昇殿.description: This auspicious formation brings justice to the forefront of the situation.  No conspiracies or hidden agendas can escape the flame of Ding.  Relationships, battles, and business are all favored when Ding reaches the West, as this is the case.

✭ real deceit 真詐.name: real deceit
✭ real deceit 真詐.description: Suitable for meditation, praying, healing, and growth.  The Great Moon is the spirit of the night and guards over the Yin nature of rejuvenation, consciousness, and awareness.

✭ double deceit 重詐.name: double deceit
✭ double deceit 重詐.description: Double Deceit is an extremely advantageous formation to enhance the capable appearance of the individual.  Competitors and enemies will find it difficult to gauge your status, and you will appear with much more potential than reality holds.  This formation is also suitable for families, relationships, self improvement, and defense.

✭ noble deceit 休詐.name: noble deceit
✭ noble deceit 休詐.description: This structure is formed when Harmony meets a Three Wonder at an auspicious Door.  The deity of Harmony governs personal affairs and relationships.  This formation will enhance the signal of trust, surrounding one with an aura of influence and fame.  Enemies may mistaken you as one who is not a threat, perhaps leading them to a hasty, wrong action.  This formation is suitable for those seeking help, rejuvenation, or enlightenment.

✭ heaven conceal 天假.name: heaven conceal
✭ heaven conceal 天假.description: The Heaven Spirit is responsible for vision, intuition, and the future.  The heaven conceal formation brings the element of bad luck to within one's control.  This formation is most useful for gaining alliances, influencing those in power, and making plans to progress in academics or career.  Gaining traction in numbers is the focus of the structure.

✭ earth conceal 地假.name: earth conceal
✭ earth conceal 地假.description: Man hides in Mountain in this auspicious formation of camouflage.  This cloak will make investigation and exploration positive.  One may be able to slip by obstacles at ease.  This formation is suitable for remaining undetected.

✭ man fake 人假.name: man fake
✭ man fake 人假.description: Originally used for arresting criminals and finding missing people, this formation brings justice to the forefront.  Travelling is well supported, as the heaven spirit will guide those who wish to avoid tragedies.

✭ deity fake 神假.name: deity fake
✭ deity fake 神假.description: The deity concel formation is suitable for meditation, traversing the inner consciousness, and finding oneself on the right path.  The divine will bring forth energy to those who are concentrated on self improvement.

✭ ghost fake 鬼假.name: ghost fake
✭ ghost fake 鬼假.description: The Ghost Fake formation depicts stillness within darkness.  Those who activate this formation will discover a journey towards the inner mandala, recognizing the elements that defines the Self.  This auspicious formation is suitable for planning and staging before a grand attack.

✭ Sun Prospers 日旺.name: Sun Prospers
✭ Sun Prospers 日旺.description: The Yi Wonder glows in the palaces of Xun and Kan, suggesting fame and recognition.  Those who wish to expand their business will find that resources and alliance support will come to aid.  This formation indicates an opportunity to show their talents -- if one choose to take it.  Finance, investments, and trade are benefited, and fortune may come.

✭ Moon Prospers 月旺.name: Moon Prospers
✭ Moon Prospers 月旺.description: Bing fire is the right hand of Jia.  When in the right palace (Xun or Zhen), this auspicious formation suggests a sudden turn of luck as a helpful ally will appear to offer encouragement or a sudden windfall will lift one out of troubles.  One will then find the motivation necessary to climb upwards.

✭ Star Prospers 星旺.name: Star Prospers
✭ Star Prospers 星旺.description: This auspicoius formation depicts the Ding noble wandering into a garden of dreams.  One may find that their goals will come closer to achievement.  Insights will spring into the mind, allowing one to utilize streams of creativity to further advance.  The horizon of aspirations stretches far and wide.

✭ super assisting 相佐格.name: super assisting
✭ super assisting 相佐格.description: This formation is suitable for forming relationships with others -- gaining new allies and friends, seeking knowledge from mentors, and reestablshing old ties.  One must be careful to stay focused on the subject at hand and not stray from the goal.  Mentors and helpers may give positive energy to support your endeavors.

✭ Huan Yi / Quan Yi 歡怡 權怡.name: Huan Yi / Quan Yi
✭ Huan Yi / Quan Yi 歡怡 權怡.description: This auspicious fomation depicts a legendary warrior training at dawn.  Suitable for matters that require intense effort to succeed, this formation is supreme in that a Three Wonder from the heavens meet with the Jia on Earth.  With persistence, success will not be unattainable.

✭ three wonder spirit 三奇之靈.name: three wonder spirit
✭ three wonder spirit 三奇之靈.description: This auspicious formation will help one develop a clear path as one strives forward.  Strengths and weaknesses will be revealed.  This formation does not automatically guarantee success, but will come to great aid if preparation and planning is in order.

⨂ vicious white tiger 白虎猖狂.name: vicious white tiger
⨂ vicious white tiger 白虎猖狂.description: Xin is the knife that cuts Yi Wood.  The vicious white tiger indicates that a storm is ahead.  One should be careful with every step and avoid drastic decisions.  If one is uncertain, calm meditative practices may be wise to secure a decision.  Relationships, marriages, new constructions, and new business plans should be carefully considered.

⨂ entangled snake 勝蛇妖嬌.name: entangled snake
⨂ entangled snake 勝蛇妖嬌.description: Gui water rains on flame.  An entangled snake is one which cannot smoothly proceed without conflict.  One will find that in order to reach a conclusion, small and minor issues must be resolved before giant steps can be taken.

⨂ green dragon runs away 青龍逃走.name: green dragon runs away
⨂ green dragon runs away 青龍逃走.description: The Green Dragon indicates prosperity and fortune, but this formation indicates that the confident energy is absent.  One should think twice before making dramatic changes.  It is advised to take the calm road at this moment.

⨂ sparrow dives into river 朱雀投江.name: sparrow dives into river
⨂ sparrow dives into river 朱雀投江.description: Arguments and conflicts may escalate into serious battles.  When the Ding wonder enters water, the flame is lost.

⨂ shimmering white 熒惑入白.name: shimmering white
⨂ shimmering white 熒惑入白.description: Also known as Mars Enters Venus.  Time will be the most valuable asset, as this structure suggests danger lurking ahead.  One should look for obstacles and traps before pushing forward into battle.  Wisdom suggests reconsidering one's options -- perhaps finding an alternate route to the destination.

⨂ white enters dark 太白入熒.name: white enters dark
⨂ white enters dark 太白入熒.description: Also known as Venus Enters Mars, this formation favors the guest and suppresses the host.  Geng metal is the enemy of Jia, and this special formation depicts a rising inauspicious light.  One should approach the matter proactively (as the guest) in order to secure the victory.

⨂ punishment 刑格.name: punishment
⨂ punishment 刑格.description: This inauspicious formation depicts a pattern of chaos spiralling out of control.  Geng meets with Ji to trap the Jia.  Not suitable for financial decisions, legal entanglements, negotiations, or disputes

⨂ war configuration 戰格.name: war configuration
⨂ war configuration 戰格.description: This inauspicious formation suggests tragic loss and disaster.  With both Geng metals as the stems, danger could lie ahead if one is not careful.

⨂ three wonders setting 奇格.name: three wonders setting
⨂ three wonders setting 奇格.description: Geng is the mortal enemy of Jia.  In this inauspicious combination, Geng metal combines with one of the Three Wonders -- Yi, Bing, and Ding.  This formation is not suitable for matters related to conflict or competition.  One must be careful when dealing with money matters.  If Yi is combined, Guest is favored.  If Bing or Ding is combined, Host is favored.

⨂ flying stem 飛干格.name: flying stem
⨂ flying stem 飛干格.description: Obstacles reveal themselves every day, but this one will affect one's relationship in the professional world.  This inauspicious formation creates problems for the individual.

⨂ big configuration 大格.name: big configuration
⨂ big configuration 大格.description: This inauspicious formation illustrates that an important element of the solution is missing.  One cannot proceed without having a complete set of tools and support for the situation.

⨂ small configuration 小格.name: small configuration
⨂ small configuration 小格.description: This inauspicious structure depicts a military strategist trapped in a continuous mental cycle with no new ideas to proceed.  This structure directly affects the ego and self esteem of an individual, limiting his ability to formulate.

⨂ flying palace 天乙飛宮格.name: flying palace
⨂ flying palace 天乙飛宮格.description: This inauspicious formation harms both host and guest.  It depicts that although a general can control his troops, he cannot control the weather.  Forces outside of the general's control will throw curve his plans, which may need to be adapted to the new environment.

⨂ sitting palace 天乙伏宮格.name: sitting palace
⨂ sitting palace 天乙伏宮格.description: This formation indicates a loss of leadership vission.  Subordinates may lose faith; co-workers may distrust.  The mission will stagnate as obstacles will emerge to hinder progress.  The future is blurry, and one should tread carefully when making decisions.

⨂ three wonders in tomb 月奇入基.name: three wonders in tomb
⨂ three wonders in tomb 月奇入基.description: The Three Wonders (Yi, Bing, Ding) is the cornerstone of Qi Men Dun Jia.  In this formation, a Wonder is in tomb (palace).  Efforts will slowly progress.  Positive matters will turn negative.  Support will dwindle and relationships may be impacted.  Critical decisions are better off delayed as the storm passes.  At this point, hesitation may be a wise choice.

⨂ three wonders suppressed 三奇受制.name: three wonders suppressed
⨂ three wonders suppressed 三奇受制.description: This neutral formation indicates one of the Three Wonders landing in a palace that supresses its strength.  As the job of a Wonder is to protect the Jia, this formation suggests that the Wonder is unable to perform its duty to the fullest extent.  However, hope is not lost.

⨂ six crest strike penalty 六儀擊刑.name: six crest strike penalty
⨂ six crest strike penalty 六儀擊刑.description: The Six Crest Penalty is an inauspicious formation that denotes an individual being pressed against a wall from all sides, leaving no room for escape.  This causes an emotional disaster, as the individual is forced to make a choice with no positive outcome.
